name: AI Companion Emotional Connection Benchmark
description: An open benchmark that defines emotional connection in AI characters and companions as eight observable behaviors (listening, emotional attunement, curiosity and follow-through, calibrated validation, conversational continuity, character consistency, emotional range, and respect for user agency) and provides test cases, 0-5 rubrics, a failure-mode taxonomy and scoring tools for evaluating them in everyday, SFW conversation.
